scene: High oblique aerial view of a gently winding Nile in ancient Egypt, with a very narrow strip of green plants and small fields on BOTH banks. alt: A winding river and narrow green banks pass through a broad pale desert.
title: A country a few miles wide
caption: Egypt is mostly desert. Nearly everyone lived in the green strip.
